full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of a sliced spleen specimen. The cut surface demonstrates marked dark red discoloration and engorgement. The architectural pattern shows prominent red pulp congestion. These findings are characteristic of acute or chronic passive congestion of the spleen, often associated with portal hypertension or cardiac failure.
